svg.title: Onam platform overview: from assets to a secure, optimized and resilient cloud
svg.desc: Data from seven clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes) and eight SaaS platforms flows into Onam Estate, the cloud asset intelligence layer that discovers, inventories, maps relationships, enriches and keeps a unified asset graph current. Five domains act on it: cloud security, data security and compliance (Onam Security), cost (Onam FinOps) and disaster recovery (Onam DRM). Onam Operations, in early access, puts AI agents across the platform that investigate with evidence and propose changes for human approval. Remediation runs through fix guidance, AI code fixes on review branches, Jira and ServiceNow tickets and alerts. Outcomes: reduced risk, lower cloud costs, recovery readiness, audit readiness and one view for every team. Compliance frameworks are mapped, not certified. Source: onam-platform-overview-SOURCES.md.
svg.text: From Assets to a Secure, Optimized and Resilient Cloud
One platform for cloud asset intelligence, security, FinOps, data security and disaster recovery
AI agents across the platform: ask in plain language, see the plan, get evidence for every claim, approve proposed changes.
Asset and Security agents first, on AWS · kill switch and full audit trail · the AI Assistant in Onam Security is available today.
AI code fix on a review branch
REST API, Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, PagerDuty
